<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum, peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm – six distinct signals corresponding to the carbons of an aromatic ring. The peak at 160.80 ppm is a carbonyl carbon attached to the ring, not aromatic. Therefore, the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
